newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends up on lower dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends up on lower dollar demand.

text.p: Bangladesh taka edged up to 42.5430/42.5480 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5440/42.5500 as demand for the US currency slid in a quiet market, dealers said.

Dealers said the taka opened steady at 42.5450/42.5500, but gained later because dollar demand was sqeezed in the absence of any major import activity. "This is mainly due to the weekend closure of most international markets," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended unchanged at 4.0 percent to 4.75 percent, dealers said.
